fishing: WHEN: Wed Nov 4; winds easing, sheltered Lemon Bay / passes best after prior blows. PASSES-BEACH: redfish, flounder, pompano, sheepshead near Stump Pass / Englewood Beach / Manasota on live shrimp, gold spoons. LEMON BAY: redfish, snook, trout, sheepshead, mangrove snapper on docks, mangroves, oyster bars, flats, Chadwick pier. NEARSHORE: mangrove snapper / cobia when calm. Baits: live shrimp, pilchards, soft plastics, weedless gold spoons, popping cork. Sources: FL Sportsman SW (Capt. Greg Stamper recent windy low water concentrating fish), Fishin Franks / Capt. Mike Manasota Key Outfitters, Waterline reports.
redtide: FWC late Oct: K. brevis not observed in Southwest Florida past week. Bloom concentrations in NW FL Bay/Gulf counties. No SWFL fish kills or respiratory irritation near Englewood/Manasota.
bacteria: Charlotte/Sarasota Healthy Beaches all Good. Englewood Beach / Manasota Key / Palm Island GOOD (~10 CFU/100mL recent samples). No advisories.
fpl: Charlotte ~2, Sarasota ~149 outages (minor/isolated); no major Englewood/Manasota impact.
